checks.evidence: Wording varies: nav and pricing "Book a free review"; index.html hero "Start with a free month-end review"; contact.html H1 "Book your free month-end review". Present on the key pages but the wording varies: partial.
Form at /contact, linked from the nav and the hero CTA on index.html. Easy to find.
contact.html: 10 fields, 7 required, including "revenue" (Annual revenue, required) and "phone" (required). Revenue and phone required up front: 0.

pricing.html: "$349/month", "From $299/location/month", "Quoted per month of backlog". No currency code. The company sells in Canada and the US (about.html), so a bare "$" is ambiguous. Catch-up has no range. Prices shown but currency ambiguous: partial.
No proof on pricing.html or contact.html. No privacy link or notice on contact.html, the page with the form. Neither: 0.
No viewport meta tag on index, pricing, about or contact. None: 0.

findings.finding: The contact form asks for 10 fields, 7 required, including annual revenue and phone.
findings.evidence: contact.html: first_name, last_name, email, phone, restaurant, locations, pos, revenue, current_bookkeeper, message. Required: first_name, last_name, email, phone, restaurant, locations, revenue.
findings.fix: Cut the form to four visible fields: first name, email, restaurant name, number of locations. Move revenue and phone to the call, and make current_bookkeeper and message optional or remove them.

findings.finding: Prices have no currency and the catch-up price has no range.
findings.fix: Add CAD or USD after each price. Replace the catch-up line with a range, e.g. "From $X to $Y per month of backlog", or say what drives the quote.

findings.finding: The primary CTA is worded three ways.
findings.evidence: index.html: "Book a free review" (nav) and "Start with a free month-end review" (hero); contact.html H1 "Book your free month-end review".
findings.fix: Use one phrase everywhere, e.g. "Book a free month-end review", in the nav, the hero, pricing and the contact H1.

findings.finding: The form page has no proof and no privacy notice.
findings.evidence: contact.html has no testimonial, logo or privacy link. The only testimonial is on index.html.
findings.fix: Place the Maria Okafor quote (with her name, business and location count) beside the contact form. Add a privacy policy link under the Submit button.

findings.finding: No page declares a viewport, so mobile rendering is not set.
findings.evidence: No <meta name="viewport"> on any of the four saved pages.
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the head of every page, then check the contact form on a phone.

strengths: One click from the nav or the hero reaches a form (contact.html).
Pricing page points to the same contact path as the home page.
not_observable: Form completion rate and lead volume (no analytics access).
Whether form submissions reach a person and how fast they are answered.
